name: @pipeworx/mcp-lichess

tools.name: user
tools.description: Fetch a Lichess player's public profile by username, including ratings across all variants (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, chess960, etc.) and account metadata.

tools.name: users
tools.description: Bulk lookup of up to 300 users by username.

tools.name: user_status
tools.description: Online / playing status for the given usernames (up to 100).

tools.name: user_performance
tools.description: Single-variant performance + best rated game for a user.

perf.description: bullet | blitz | rapid | classical | correspondence | chess960 | crazyhouse | antichess | atomic | horde | kingOfTheHill | racingKings | threeCheck | ultraBullet

tools.name: top_players
tools.description: Lichess leaderboard for a single chess variant: the highest-rated Lichess accounts in one perf (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, correspondence, chess960, crazyhouse, atomic, antichess, horde, kingOfTheHill, racingKings, threeCheck, ultraBullet), up to 200 entries. Returns each player username, title, and current rating in that variant. Answers who the top-rated blitz or bullet players on Lichess are right now.

tools.name: leaderboards
tools.description: Fetch the top-10 rated players across every Lichess variant in a single call; returns one ranked list per variant (bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, and more).

tools.name: cloud_eval
tools.description: Stockfish cloud evaluation for a FEN position.

tools.name: tablebase
tools.description: Syzygy tablebase lookup (≤7 pieces). Variant: standard (default), atomic, antichess.

tools.name: opening_explorer
tools.description: Opening explorer. scope: "lichess" (community), "masters" (top 2200+ humans), "player" (single user). As of mid-2026 Lichess began requiring a Personal API Token on every explorer.lichess.ovh request — pass yours via _apiKey. Create one (free) at https://lichess.org/account/oauth/token; no scopes required for read-only Explorer access.

play.description: UCI move list, comma-separated. Mutually exclusive with fen.

moves.description: Number of top moves to return (default 12, max 64).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-lichess forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the lichess pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
